modes.backstop: recovery market from the last checkpoint, paid challenger, bond, the case's attempt cap
modes.single: the primary alone: one attempt, no recovery market, no challenger
modes.retries: the primary alone, retrying from its own checkpoint under the same cap, guarantee and budget; no market, no challenger
modes.no-market: Backstop without the recovery market: the failed primary retries from its own checkpoint
modes.no-bond: Backstop without the bond: no guarantor, no premium, no compensation, recovery paid from escrow only
